title: Inside FINS Initiative - Integrated National Financing Frameworks
shortDescription: High-level documentary series and 15 animated training modules filmed on location in the Dominican Republic, translating sovereign development financing (INFFs) into actionable stories for national ministries.
mandateChallenge: Make complex macroeconomic policy and sovereign financing mechanisms tangible and relatable for Small Island Developing States (SIDS) policymakers and international development partners.
executionCraft: Directed location shoots in the Dominican Republic, engineered a modular After Effects motion system for 15 training modules, and structured the companion Drupal 10 video platform.
